activity_statements.statement: operates as a relationship-driven commercial bank serving middle-market businesses, owner-operators, commercial real estate clients, and affluent households primarily across Southeastern and Mid-Atlantic US markets
provides commercial lending including lines of credit, term loans, commercial real estate financing, and working capital facilities to business clients
offers treasury management and payments services enabling corporate clients to manage cash flows, receivables, and disbursements
delivers wealth management and private banking services for business owners, executives, and affluent individuals
provides specialty lending to healthcare and other licensed professionals nationally through BHG Financial (formerly Bankers Healthcare Group), acquired in 2021
operates through a banker-centric model of recruiting experienced local financial services professionals and giving them significant local client authority backed by centralized credit discipline
trades on NYSE (PNFP) with market capitalization of approximately $14.5B and corporate headquarters in Nashville, TN with expanding Atlanta presence

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Financial Services & Insurance' is broader than Pinnacle's actual focus; Pinnacle is a pure commercial bank (no insurance), but its BHG Financial subsidiary providing national specialty lending to medical professionals makes it meaningfully different from a typical community or regional bank.
extraction_notes: pnfp.com/about and /personal-banking returned 404; homepage provided minimal content. Substantial operational detail sourced from umbrex.com third-party company profile based on Pinnacle's public filings. BHG Financial details from public knowledge of 2021 acquisition.
